"""Nootka forest-section model: one run = one possible 50-year future of one design.

Uncertain knowledge (PARAMS, growth rates) is sampled once per run from stream 1 of the seed.
Year-to-year chance (events, which tree dies) comes from stream 2 and is drawn up front, so two
designs run with the same seed meet exactly the same events (common random numbers).
The model tracks habitat conditions, not birds. Competition is limited to shade from taller neighbouring trees."""
import numpy as np
from .species import TREES, SHRUBS, NATIVE_SHRUBS, WINTER_SHARE, PARAMS, H0, months
from .site import OUT

TN = list(TREES)
SN = list(SHRUBS)
SENS = {"high": 1.0, "med": 0.5, "low": 0.15}
TESTS = ["J1", "J2", "J3", "J4", "H1", "H2", "H3", "H4"]
SERIES = ["eco", "jay", "hum", "structure", "diversity", "canopy", "three_layers", "months", "nectar_early",
          "berry", "open", "conifers_alive", "nest_trees", "trees_alive", "trees_stressed", "died", "died_young", "planted", "first_alive", "shrub_cover", "invaded",
          "d_dry", "d_heat", "d_dry2", "d_age", "d_shade", "d_wind"] + TESTS
EVENTS = ["dry", "dry2", "heat", "wind", "wind_extreme", "snow", "budget_cut"]
CAUSES = ["dry summer", "heat wave", "second dry summer in a row", "end of lifespan", "shade", "wind storm"]
# management settings. The first four are the ones the engine explores in run 0; the rest are set by the designer.
DEFAULT_DEC = dict(winter=0, thin=0, water=2, nurse=0,
                   water_dry=0,                # emergency watering of established trees in dry summers
                   replant="same",             # same | tolerant (a conifer lost to drought comes back as Douglas-fir) | none
                   inv_every=1,                # invasive plants cleared every N years; 0 = never
                   thin_start=10, thin_every=5, thin_method="remove",     # glade: remove | lift (raise the crown, keep the tree) | small (only trees up to 8 m)
                   alder_out=0)                # year the red alders are taken out to release the conifers; 0 = left to their natural lifespan
SWITCHES = ["dry", "heat", "wind", "snow", "ivy", "trample", "budget"]   # event modules that can be switched off
# draft thresholds (Nootka parameters tab, mid-range)
TH = dict(nest_h=8.0, nest_n=3, cover10=0.5, cover_n=2, three=0.40, berry=0.10, months=9, nectar=0.05, open=0.30)


def default_design(site, swap=None):
    """Viola's plan as drawn. swap: {plot id: species} overrides."""
    sp = [(swap or {}).get(t["id"], t["species"]) for t in site["trees"]]
    return dict(trees=sp, patch_mix=None)


def run(site, design, dec=None, seed=0, years=50, record=False, events=True, weights=None):
    dec = {**DEFAULT_DEC, **(dec or {})}
    on = (lambda k: bool(events.get(k, True))) if isinstance(events, dict) else (lambda k: bool(events))
    ep = np.random.default_rng([seed, 1]); al = np.random.default_rng([seed, 2])
    par = {k: ep.uniform(*v) for k, v in PARAMS.items()}
    g_s = {s: ep.uniform(*TREES[s]["growth"]) for s in TN}
    hm_s = {s: ep.uniform(*TREES[s]["hmax"]) for s in TN}
    life_s = {s: (ep.uniform(*TREES[s]["life"]) if TREES[s]["life"] else 1e9) for s in TN}
    nurse_delay = int(ep.integers(5, 11)); cut_len = int(ep.integers(2, 6))

    nt, npch = len(site["trees"]), len(site["patches"]); shape = site["cls"].shape
    U = al.random((years, 6)); UT = al.random((years, nt, 4)); UG = al.random((years, 2) + shape)

    sp = list(design["trees"])
    tx = np.array([t["X"] for t in site["trees"]]); ty = np.array([t["Y"] for t in site["trees"]])
    DIST = np.hypot(tx[:, None] - tx[None, :], ty[:, None] - ty[None, :])
    r = np.zeros(nt)

    def traits():
        return dict(G=np.array([g_s[x] for x in sp]), HM=np.array([hm_s[x] for x in sp]), LIFE=np.array([life_s[x] for x in sp]),
                    CA=np.array([TREES[x]["crown"][0] for x in sp]), CB=np.array([TREES[x]["crown"][1] for x in sp]), CR=np.array([TREES[x]["crown"][2] for x in sp]),
                    CON=np.array([TREES[x]["conifer"] for x in sp], bool), DS=np.array([SENS[TREES[x]["drought"]] for x in sp]),
                    WIND=np.array([par["wind_" + TREES[x]["wind"]] for x in sp]),
                    SHADE=np.array([{"low": 1.0, "med": 0.5, "high": 0.1}[TREES[x]["shade"]] for x in sp]),      # sensitivity to shade
                    SNOWLOW=np.array([TREES[x]["snow"] == "low" for x in sp]), CEDAR=np.array([x == "Western red cedar" for x in sp]),
                    SPRUCE=np.array([x == "Sitka spruce" for x in sp]), MAPLE=np.array(["maple" in x for x in sp]), VINE=np.array([x == "Vine maple" for x in sp]),
                    ALDER=np.array([x == "Red alder" for x in sp]), SPI=np.array([TN.index(x) for x in sp]))
    T = traits(); G, HM, LIFE, CA, CB, CR, CON, DS, WIND, SHADE, SNOWLOW, CEDAR, SPRUCE, MAPLE, VINE, ALDER, SPI = T.values()
    plant_year = np.where(CON & bool(dec["nurse"]), nurse_delay, 0)
    alive = np.zeros(nt, bool); thinned = np.zeros(nt, bool); age = np.zeros(nt); h = np.zeros(nt)
    ever_died = np.zeros(nt, bool); planted_n = 0; lifted = np.zeros(nt, bool); last_cause = np.full(nt, -1)
    vig = np.ones(nt); hurt = np.zeros(nt)      # vigour: running share of potential growth achieved; hurt: years since breakage

    # shrub patches: shares by species
    mix = np.zeros((npch, len(SN)))
    for k in range(npch):
        m = (design.get("patch_mix") or [None] * npch)[k] or {s: 1 / len(NATIVE_SHRUBS) for s in NATIVE_SHRUBS}
        for s, v in m.items():
            mix[k, SN.index(s)] = v
        if dec["winter"]:
            mix[k] *= 1 - WINTER_SHARE; mix[k, SN.index("Winter mahonia")] += WINTER_SHARE
    BLOOM = np.array([[m in months(SHRUBS[s]["bloom"]) for m in range(1, 13)] for s in SN], float)   # species x month
    NECT = np.array([SHRUBS[s]["nectar"] for s in SN]); BERRY = np.array([SHRUBS[s]["berry"] for s in SN], float)
    SSENS = np.array([SENS[SHRUBS[s]["drought"]] for s in SN]); SHOK = np.array([SHRUBS[s]["shade_ok"] for s in SN])
    SHT = np.array([SHRUBS[s]["height"] for s in SN])
    cover = np.zeros(npch)

    green = site["green"]; gflat = green.ravel(); ng = gflat.sum(); garea = ng * site["cs"] ** 2
    inflat = (site["cls"] != OUT).ravel()
    near10 = (site["d2"] <= 100.0) & inflat[None, :]
    pcells = [c.ravel() for c in site["patch_cells"]]; anyp = (site["patch_id"] >= 0).ravel()
    parea = site["patch_area"]
    pathedge = green & (site["dist_path"] <= 2.0)
    inv = np.zeros(shape, bool); comp = np.zeros(shape)
    ti, tj = site["tree_cell"]
    w = weights or dict(structure=1, diversity=1, bloom=1, canopy=1, jay=1, hum=1)
    out = {k: np.zeros(years) for k in SERIES}; ev = {k: np.zeros(years, bool) for k in EVENTS}
    rec = [] if record else None
    prev_dry = False; cut_left = 0

    for t in range(years):
        f = t / max(years - 1, 1)
        dry = on("dry") and U[t, 0] < par["p_dry0"] + f * (par["p_dry50"] - par["p_dry0"])
        heat = on("heat") and U[t, 1] < par["p_heat0"] + f * (par["p_heat50"] - par["p_heat0"])
        wind = on("wind") and U[t, 2] < par["p_wind"]; windx = on("wind") and U[t, 2] < par["p_wind_x"]
        snow = on("snow") and U[t, 3] < par["p_snow"]
        if cut_left > 0: cut_left -= 1
        elif on("budget") and U[t, 4] < par["p_cut"]: cut_left = cut_len
        care = cut_left == 0
        dry2 = dry and prev_dry

        # planting and replacement of losses (only under active care)
        new = (~alive) & (~thinned) & (plant_year <= t) & ((plant_year == t) | (care & (dec["replant"] != "none")))
        if dec["replant"] == "tolerant":         # a conifer lost to drought is replaced with Douglas-fir
            swap = new & ever_died & CON & np.isin(last_cause, (0, 2))
            if swap.any():
                for k in np.where(swap)[0]: sp[k] = "Douglas-fir"
                T = traits(); G, HM, LIFE, CA, CB, CR, CON, DS, WIND, SHADE, SNOWLOW, CEDAR, SPRUCE, MAPLE, VINE, ALDER, SPI = T.values()
        alive[new] = True; age[new] = 0; h[new] = H0; vig[new] = 1.0; hurt[new] = 99; planted_n = int(new.sum())

        watered = (age < dec["water"]) & care
        stressed = dry & ~watered
        gf = np.where(age < 2, 0.3, 1.0) * np.where(stressed, 1 - (1 - par["dry_growth"]) * DS / 1.0, 1.0)
        # shade from taller neighbours (last year's crowns): 0 = open, 1 = stem fully under a taller crown
        taller = alive[None, :] & (h[None, :] > h[:, None] + 2.0)
        shm = np.where(taller, np.clip((r[None, :] + 1.0 - DIST) / 2.0, 0, 1), 0.0)
        shd = shm.max(1) * (h < 10); shader = shm.argmax(1)
        gf = gf * (1 - par["shade_growth"] * SHADE * shd)
        vig = 0.7 * vig + 0.3 * gf / np.where(age < 2, 0.3, 1.0)
        h = np.where(alive, h + G * gf * np.clip(1 - (h / HM) ** 2, 0, 1), 0.0)

        young = age < 5
        shelter = np.where(CON & bool(dec["nurse"]), par["shelter"], 1.0)
        # causes of death this year, each with its own chance; one draw per tree decides if it dies and of what
        steep = np.where(site["tree_slope"] > 20, 1.3, 1.0)
        rescue = par["rescue"] if (dec["water_dry"] and care) else 1.0      # emergency watering of established trees
        comps = [np.where(stressed, np.where(young, par["dry_young"] * shelter, par["dry_old"] * rescue) * DS / 0.5, 0.0) * steep,
                 np.where(young & (shelter == 1.0), par["heat_young"], 0.0) * (1.0 if heat else 0.0),
                 np.where(~young, par["cedar_dieback"] * rescue * (CEDAR + 0.5 * SPRUCE), 0.0) * (1.0 if dry2 else 0.0),
                 np.where(age > LIFE, 0.08, 0.0),
                 par["shade_mort"] * SHADE * shd]
        cum = np.cumsum(comps, 0); u = UT[t, :, 0]
        die = alive & (u < cum[-1]); cause = np.minimum((u[None, :] >= cum).sum(0), len(comps) - 1)
        blown = np.zeros(nt, bool); brk = np.zeros(nt, bool)
        if wind:
            pw = WIND * np.clip((h / 20.0) ** 2, 0, 2.5) * np.where(site["tree_edge"], 1.5, 1.0)
            pw = pw * np.where(inv[ti, tj], 1.3, 1.0) * (1.2 if thinned.any() else 1.0) * (4.0 if windx else 1.0)
            blown = alive & ~die & (h > 6) & (UT[t, :, 1] < pw); die |= blown; cause[blown] = 5
        if snow:
            brk = alive & SNOWLOW & (h > 3) & (UT[t, :, 2] < par["snow_dmg"])
            h[brk] *= 0.85; hurt[brk] = 0
        died_young = int((die & (age < 5)).sum()); ever_died |= die; last_cause[die] = cause[die]; lifted[die] = False
        by_cause = np.bincount(cause[die], minlength=6)
        alive &= ~die; h[~alive] = 0; age[~alive] = 0; age[alive] += 1; hurt += 1
        # health class per tree: 0 dead or not yet planted, 1 stressed, 2 good (J: thresholds)
        health = np.where(alive, np.where((vig < 0.75) | (hurt <= 3) | (age > LIFE), 1, 2), 0)

        r = np.where(alive, np.minimum(CA * h + CB, CR), 0.0)
        crown = site["d2"] <= (r ** 2)[:, None]
        crown &= alive[:, None]
        can = crown.any(0)

        # glade management: open the canopy over the shrub patches. The method is the designer's choice.
        gl = []; lf = []; al_out = []
        cano = crown[~lifted].any(0); canl = crown[lifted].any(0) & ~cano
        if dec["thin"] and t >= dec["thin_start"] and (t - dec["thin_start"]) % max(1, dec["thin_every"]) == 0 \
                and cano[anyp].mean() + par["lift_left"] * canl[anyp].mean() > 0.4:
            ok = alive & ~CON & ~lifted & ((h <= 8.0) if dec["thin_method"] == "small" else True)
            over = np.where(ok, (crown & anyp[None, :]).sum(1), 0)
            if over.max() > 0:
                k = int(over.argmax())
                if dec["thin_method"] == "lift": lifted[k] = True; lf.append(k)
                else:
                    alive[k] = False; thinned[k] = True; h[k] = 0; age[k] = 0; health[k] = 0; crown[k] = False; gl.append(k)
        # red alder taken out in a chosen year to release the conifers
        if dec["alder_out"] and t + 1 == dec["alder_out"]:
            for k in np.where(alive & ALDER)[0]:
                alive[k] = False; thinned[k] = True; h[k] = 0; age[k] = 0; health[k] = 0; crown[k] = False; al_out.append(int(k))
        r = np.where(alive, r, 0.0); can = crown.any(0)
        cano = crown[~lifted].any(0); canl = crown[lifted].any(0) & ~cano
        tall = crown[h > 6].any(0) if (h > 6).any() else np.zeros_like(can)
        sub = crown[(h >= 1.5) & (h <= 6)].any(0) if ((h >= 1.5) & (h <= 6)).any() else np.zeros_like(can)

        # invasive plants and trampling
        if on("ivy"):
            if U[t, 5] < par["p_ivy"]:
                e = np.where(site["entry"], UG[t, 0], -1.0); inv.flat[int(e.argmax())] = True
            nb = np.zeros(shape, bool)
            nb[1:] |= inv[:-1]; nb[:-1] |= inv[1:]; nb[:, 1:] |= inv[:, :-1]; nb[:, :-1] |= inv[:, 1:]
            inv |= nb & green & (UG[t, 0] < par["ivy_spread"])
            if care and dec["inv_every"] and t % dec["inv_every"] == 0: inv[:] = False      # cleared on the chosen cycle, while the site is under care
        if on("trample"):
            comp = np.minimum(1.0, comp + 0.1 * (pathedge & (UG[t, 1] < par["p_trample"])))
        invf = inv.ravel()

        # shrub patches
        cover = np.minimum(1.0, cover + 0.2)
        if dry and not (t < dec["water"] and care):
            cover *= 1 - par["shrub_dry"] * (mix * SSENS).sum(1)
        cc = np.array([cano[c].mean() + par["lift_left"] * canl[c].mean() if c.any() else 0.0 for c in pcells])            # canopy over each patch
        pinv = np.array([invf[c].mean() if c.any() else 0.0 for c in pcells])
        shade = np.clip(1 - (cc[:, None] - SHOK[None, :]) / 0.4, 0, 1)                # patch x species flowering factor
        eff = parea[:, None] * (cover * (1 - pinv))[:, None] * mix                      # m2 of each shrub species
        flower = (eff * shade * (0.7 if heat else 1.0)) @ BLOOM                        # patch x month, m2 in flower
        fl_m = flower.sum(0) / garea
        maple_bloom = bool((alive & MAPLE & (h > 3)).any())
        present = fl_m > 0.005
        if maple_bloom: present[2:6] = True
        nmonths = int(present.sum())
        nect = ((eff * shade * (NECT >= 0.6)[None, :]) @ BLOOM)[:, 1:4].sum(0).max() / garea
        berry = (eff * BERRY[None, :]).sum() / garea
        pheight = min(1.0, (t + 1) / 6) * (mix * SHT).sum(1)

        # layers per green cell
        ground = gflat & ~invf & (comp.ravel() <= 0.6)
        pc = np.zeros(gflat.shape, bool)
        for k, c in enumerate(pcells):
            if cover[k] >= 0.5: pc |= c
        shr = (pc | sub) & gflat
        layers = ground.astype(int) + shr + (tall & gflat)
        structure = layers[gflat].mean() / 3; three = (layers[gflat] == 3).mean()
        canopy = can[gflat].mean(); openshare = 1 - canopy

        nest = alive & CON & (h >= TH["nest_h"])
        J1 = nest.sum() >= TH["nest_n"]
        c10 = np.array([can[near10[i]].mean() for i in np.where(nest)[0]]) if nest.any() else np.array([])
        J2 = (c10 >= TH["cover10"]).sum() >= TH["cover_n"]
        J3 = three >= TH["three"]; J4 = berry >= TH["berry"]
        H1 = nmonths >= TH["months"]; H2 = nect >= TH["nectar"]
        H3 = bool(nect > 0 and ((alive & VINE & (h >= 2)).any() or (pheight >= 2).any()))
        H4 = openshare >= TH["open"]
        tests = [J1, J2, J3, J4, H1, H2, H3, H4]
        jay = sum(tests[:4]) / 4; hum = sum(tests[4:]) / 4
        areas = np.concatenate([np.bincount(SPI, weights=np.pi * r ** 2, minlength=len(TN)), eff.sum(0)])
        p = areas[areas > 0] / areas.sum() if areas.sum() > 0 else np.array([1.0])
        diversity = float(-(p * np.log(p)).sum() / np.log(len(TN) + len(SN)))
        parts = dict(structure=structure, diversity=diversity, bloom=nmonths / 12, canopy=min(canopy / 0.6, 1), jay=jay, hum=hum)
        eco = sum(w[k] * parts[k] for k in parts) / sum(w.values())

        vals = dict(eco=eco, jay=jay, hum=hum, structure=structure, diversity=diversity, canopy=canopy, three_layers=three,
                    months=nmonths, nectar_early=nect, berry=berry, open=openshare, conifers_alive=(alive & CON).sum(),
                    nest_trees=nest.sum(), trees_alive=alive.sum(), trees_stressed=(health == 1).sum(), died=die.sum(), died_young=died_young, d_dry=by_cause[0], d_heat=by_cause[1], d_dry2=by_cause[2], d_age=by_cause[3], d_shade=by_cause[4], d_wind=by_cause[5], planted=planted_n, first_alive=(alive & ~ever_died & ~thinned).sum(), shrub_cover=float((cover * parea).sum() / parea.sum()),
                    invaded=invf[gflat].mean(), **dict(zip(TESTS, tests)))
        for k, v in vals.items(): out[k][t] = v
        for k, v in zip(EVENTS, [dry, dry2, heat, wind, windx, snow, not care]): ev[k][t] = v
        if record:
            rec.append(dict(h=h.round(2).tolist(), r=r.round(2).tolist(), alive=alive.tolist(), health=health.tolist(), thinned=thinned.tolist(), sp=list(sp), glade=gl, lifted=lf, alder_out=al_out,
                            shd=shd.round(2).tolist(), shader=shader.tolist(),
                            died=np.where(die)[0].tolist(), cause=[CAUSES[c] for c in cause[die]], blown=np.where(blown)[0].tolist(), broken=np.where(brk)[0].tolist(), age=age.tolist(),
                            cover=cover.round(2).tolist(), pcan=cc.round(2).tolist(), pinv=pinv.round(2).tolist(), inv=np.packbits(inv).tolist(), comp=np.packbits(comp > 0.6).tolist()))
        prev_dry = dry
    return dict(series=out, events=ev, species=list(design["trees"]), dec=dec, seed=seed, record=rec, params=par, nurse_delay=nurse_delay)


def recovery(series, drop=0.05):
    """Largest fall of the eco index from its running peak, and years taken to get back within 2% of that peak
    (np.nan if it never does). A simple resilience read-out per run."""
    e = np.asarray(series); peak = np.maximum.accumulate(e); dd = peak - e
    if dd.max() < drop: return 0.0, 0.0
    i = int(dd.argmax()); back = np.where(e[i:] >= peak[i] - 0.02)[0]
    return float(dd.max()), (float(back[0]) if len(back) else float("nan"))

"""Species traits. Ranges are sampled once per run (uncertain knowledge).
Sources: Nootka parameters tab and Literature review rows (see `src`). 'J' marks judgement."""

# growth m/yr after establishment, hmax m (asymptote), crown radius = a*h+b capped at rmax
TREES = {
    "Sitka spruce":      dict(conifer=1, growth=(0.30, 0.60), hmax=(26, 34), crown=(0.15, 0.5, 5.0), drought="high", wind="low",  snow="med", shade="med", life=None,
                              src="lit rows 1-6, 11"),
    "Douglas-fir":       dict(conifer=1, growth=(0.45, 0.90), hmax=(28, 38), crown=(0.16, 0.5, 5.5), drought="med",  wind="high", snow="low", life=None,
                              shade="low", src="BC Tree Species Compendium (Douglas-fir): water deficit M, heat M-H, wind H, snow L-M coastal, low light "
                                               "'exposure-requiring in humid climates', site index 50 about 40 m; UC ANR: about 0.9 m/yr at age 8-10"),
    "Grand fir":         dict(conifer=1, growth=(0.40, 0.85), hmax=(26, 34), crown=(0.15, 0.5, 5.0), drought="med",  wind="med",  snow="med", shade="med", life=None,
                              src="lit rows 25-32"),
    "Western red cedar": dict(conifer=1, growth=(0.30, 0.50), hmax=(22, 30), crown=(0.18, 0.5, 5.5), drought="med", wind="med",  snow="low", shade="high", life=None,
                              src="lit rows 13-22"),
    "Bigleaf maple":     dict(conifer=0, growth=(0.50, 1.00), hmax=(20, 28), crown=(0.30, 0.5, 8.0), drought="med",  wind="med",  snow="med", shade="med", life=None,
                              bloom=(3, 6), src="lit rows 35-43"),
    "Red alder":         dict(conifer=0, growth=(0.80, 1.50), hmax=(18, 26), crown=(0.22, 0.5, 5.0), drought="med",  wind="med",  snow="low", shade="low", life=(40, 60),
                              src="lit rows 46-55"),
    "Vine maple":        dict(conifer=0, growth=(0.20, 0.40), hmax=(5, 8),   crown=(0.45, 0.3, 3.5), drought="med",  wind="med",  snow="med", shade="high", life=None,
                              bloom=(3, 6), src="lit rows 57-62"),
}
H0 = 1.5  # height at planting, m (J)

# bloom = (first month, last month); nectar: value for Anna's hummingbird; berry: food for Steller's jay
SHRUBS = {
    "Oceanspray":   dict(height=3.0, bloom=(6, 8), nectar=0.3, berry=0, drought="low",  shade_ok=0.45),
    "Salmonberry":  dict(height=2.5, bloom=(3, 6), nectar=1.0, berry=1, drought="high", shade_ok=0.60),
    "Thimbleberry": dict(height=1.8, bloom=(4, 7), nectar=0.3, berry=1, drought="med",  shade_ok=0.45),
    "Osoberry":     dict(height=3.0, bloom=(2, 4), nectar=0.6, berry=1, drought="low",  shade_ok=0.55),
    "Snowberry":    dict(height=1.5, bloom=(5, 8), nectar=0.3, berry=1, drought="low",  shade_ok=0.50),
    "Salal":        dict(height=1.2, bloom=(5, 7), nectar=0.6, berry=1, drought="low",  shade_ok=0.33),  # lit row 100
    # decision 2 option B: adaptive winter-flowering shrub (Mahonia x media type), lit row 139
    "Winter mahonia": dict(height=2.5, bloom=(11, 1), nectar=1.0, berry=1, drought="low", shade_ok=0.60),
}
NATIVE_SHRUBS = ["Oceanspray", "Salmonberry", "Thimbleberry", "Osoberry", "Snowberry", "Salal"]

"""Build the site grid from the Rhino export (zones, parcels, contours, plots)."""
import json
import numpy as np
try:                                     # only needed to build the grid from the Rhino export; a saved site loads without them
    import shapely
    from shapely.geometry import Polygon
    from scipy.interpolate import griddata
    from scipy.ndimage import distance_transform_edt
except ImportError:
    shapely = None

OUT, OTHER, PATH, IMPERV, GREEN, SHRUB, PARCEL = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6


OVERRIDES = [[0, 24, 13.5, 31.5, 3],      # A: paved road between the two lots on the west side
             [45, 41.5, 52.5, 65.8, 6]]   # B: part of a private parcel (City parcel line is open here)


def build_site(geom_path, contours_path, plots_path, cs=1.0, overrides=OVERRIDES):
    G = json.load(open(geom_path))
    polys = {}
    for layer, closed, pts in G["curves"]:
        if closed:
            polys.setdefault(layer, []).append(Polygon([tuple(q) for q in pts]).buffer(0))
    sb = polys["Site Boundary"][0]
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = sb.bounds
    xs = np.arange(x0 + cs / 2, x1, cs)
    ys = np.arange(y0 + cs / 2, y1, cs)
    X, Y = np.meshgrid(xs, ys)
    inside = shapely.contains_xy(sb, X, Y)
    cls = np.where(inside, OTHER, OUT)
    # drawn zones from large to small, so nested islands win; private parcels are painted last:
    # nothing inside a parcel counts as green space (Viola, 24 Nov)
    zones = ([(g, PATH) for g in polys.get("PATH", [])] + [(g, IMPERV) for g in polys.get("impervious", [])]
             + [(g, GREEN) for g in polys.get("Green Space", [])] + [(g, SHRUB) for g in polys.get("shrub patches", [])])
    zones.sort(key=lambda z: -z[0].area)
    for g, c in zones:
        cls[shapely.contains_xy(g, X, Y) & inside] = c
    parcel_id = np.full(cls.shape, -1)
    for n, g in enumerate(polys.get("PARCELS", [])):
        m = shapely.contains_xy(g, X, Y) & inside
        cls[m] = PARCEL; parcel_id[m] = n
    # areas with no zone drawn: boxes in metres from the SW corner, [x0, y0, x1, y1, class]
    for bx0, by0, bx1, by1, c in (overrides or []):
        box = (X - x0 >= bx0) & (X - x0 <= bx1) & (Y - y0 >= by0) & (Y - y0 <= by1)
        cls[box & (cls == OTHER)] = c

    P = json.load(open(plots_path))["plots"]
    trees = [p for p in P if p["kind"] == "Tree"]
    patches = [p for p in P if p["kind"] != "Tree"]
    patch_id = np.full(cls.shape, -1)
    for g in polys.get("shrub patches", []):
        k = int(np.argmin([(g.centroid.x - p["X"]) ** 2 + (g.centroid.y - p["Y"]) ** 2 for p in patches]))
        patch_id[shapely.contains_xy(g, X, Y) & (cls == SHRUB)] = k

    C = json.load(open(contours_path))["contours"]
    pts = np.array([[p[0], p[1]] for c in C for p in c])
    zz = np.array([p[2] for c in C for p in c])
    E = griddata(pts, zz, (X, Y), method="linear")
    En = griddata(pts, zz, (X, Y), method="nearest")
    E = np.where(np.isnan(E), En, E)
    dzdy, dzdx = np.gradient(E, cs, cs)
    slope = np.degrees(np.arctan(np.hypot(dzdx, dzdy)))
    aspect = (np.degrees(np.arctan2(-dzdx, -dzdy)) + 360) % 360

    green = (cls == GREEN) | (cls == SHRUB)
    dist_path = distance_transform_edt(cls != PATH) * cs
    dist_out = distance_transform_edt((cls != OUT) & (cls != PARCEL)) * cs
    dist_parcel = distance_transform_edt(cls != PARCEL) * cs if (cls == PARCEL).any() else np.full(cls.shape, 1e9)
    entry = green & (dist_parcel <= 1.5 * cs)          # where invasives arrive
    if not entry.any():
        entry = green & (dist_out <= 1.5 * cs)
    tx = np.array([t["X"] for t in trees]); ty = np.array([t["Y"] for t in trees])
    d2 = (X.ravel()[None, :] - tx[:, None]) ** 2 + (Y.ravel()[None, :] - ty[:, None]) ** 2
    ti = np.clip(((ty - ys[0]) / cs).round().astype(int), 0, len(ys) - 1)
    tj = np.clip(((tx - xs[0]) / cs).round().astype(int), 0, len(xs) - 1)
    # parcel cells added by an override box join the nearest drawn parcel
    lost = (cls == PARCEL) & (parcel_id < 0)
    if lost.any() and (parcel_id >= 0).any():
        idx = distance_transform_edt(parcel_id < 0, return_distances=False, return_indices=True)
        parcel_id[lost] = parcel_id[idx[0][lost], idx[1][lost]]
    parcel_id[cls != PARCEL] = -1
    # buildings (Viola, 24 Nov): the smallest parcel in the test area is a four-storey development, the others
    # two storeys. Size is the part inside the site boundary; slivers under 50 m2 are not counted as the smallest.
    areas = [g.area for g in polys.get("PARCELS", [])]
    parcels = [dict(id=n, area=round(a, 1), inside=float((parcel_id == n).sum() * cs * cs), storeys=2) for n, a in enumerate(areas)]
    parcels = [q for q in parcels if q["inside"] > 0]
    big = [q for q in parcels if q["inside"] >= 50]
    if big: min(big, key=lambda q: q["inside"])["storeys"] = 4
    return dict(cs=cs, xs=xs, ys=ys, cls=cls, green=green, patch_id=patch_id, parcel_id=parcel_id, parcels=parcels, E=E, slope=slope, aspect=aspect,
                dist_path=dist_path, dist_out=dist_out, entry=entry, trees=trees, patches=patches,
                d2=d2, tree_cell=(ti, tj), tree_edge=dist_out[ti, tj] < 6, tree_slope=slope[ti, tj],
                patch_cells=[(patch_id == k) for k in range(len(patches))],
                patch_area=np.array([(patch_id == k).sum() * cs * cs for k in range(len(patches))]))


GRIDS = ["cls", "green", "patch_id", "parcel_id", "E", "slope", "aspect", "dist_path", "dist_out", "entry"]


def save_site(site, path):
    """Write a built site as plain JSON, so the engine can run where shapely and scipy are not installed (the browser)."""
    out = {k: np.asarray(site[k]).tolist() for k in GRIDS}
    out.update(cs=site["cs"], xs=site["xs"].tolist(), ys=site["ys"].tolist(), trees=site["trees"], patches=site["patches"], parcels=site["parcels"],
               tree_cell=[np.asarray(a).tolist() for a in site["tree_cell"]], tree_edge=np.asarray(site["tree_edge"]).tolist(),
               tree_slope=np.round(site["tree_slope"], 3).tolist(), patch_area=site["patch_area"].tolist())
    for k in ("E", "slope", "aspect", "dist_path", "dist_out"): out[k] = np.round(np.asarray(site[k], float), 3).tolist()
    json.dump(out, open(path, "w"))


def load_site(src):
    d = json.load(open(src)) if isinstance(src, str) else src
    S = {k: np.array(d[k]) for k in GRIDS}; S["green"] = S["green"].astype(bool); S["entry"] = S["entry"].astype(bool)
    S.update(cs=d["cs"], xs=np.array(d["xs"]), ys=np.array(d["ys"]), trees=d["trees"], patches=d["patches"], parcels=d["parcels"],
             tree_cell=(np.array(d["tree_cell"][0]), np.array(d["tree_cell"][1])), tree_edge=np.array(d["tree_edge"]), tree_slope=np.array(d["tree_slope"]),
             patch_area=np.array(d["patch_area"]))
    X, Y = np.meshgrid(S["xs"], S["ys"]); tx = np.array([t["X"] for t in S["trees"]]); ty = np.array([t["Y"] for t in S["trees"]])
    S["d2"] = (X.ravel()[None, :] - tx[:, None]) ** 2 + (Y.ravel()[None, :] - ty[:, None]) ** 2
    S["patch_cells"] = [(S["patch_id"] == k) for k in range(len(S["patches"]))]
    return S

"""Design exploration: the engine picks a species for every open plot, a shrub recipe and the management
choices, then meets each design with the same set of futures. Nothing here says which design is 'best':
it reports how each choice shifts the spread of outcomes, so the designer can lock what is settled and
run a narrower round."""
import json
import numpy as np
from .model import run, TESTS
from .species import TREES, NATIVE_SHRUBS

# shrub recipes: shares of each patch (J). Winter mahonia is a separate choice on top of any recipe.
RECIPES = {
    "even":    {s: 1 / 6 for s in NATIVE_SHRUBS},
    "berry":   dict(Salmonberry=0.25, Thimbleberry=0.20, Osoberry=0.20, Snowberry=0.15, Salal=0.15, Oceanspray=0.05),
    "nectar":  dict(Salmonberry=0.35, Osoberry=0.25, Salal=0.20, Oceanspray=0.10, Thimbleberry=0.05, Snowberry=0.05),
    "cover":   dict(Salal=0.40, Snowberry=0.20, Oceanspray=0.20, Osoberry=0.10, Salmonberry=0.05, Thimbleberry=0.05),
}
# management choices and their options; anything named in `locks` is held fixed
CHOICES = dict(nurse=[0, 1], thin=[0, 1], winter=[0, 1], water=[2, 5], recipe=list(RECIPES))
METRICS = ["jay", "hum", "survival", "canopy10", "canopy20", "canopy30", "canopy40", "canopy50", "structure50",
           "three50", "stressed50", "eco", "worst_drop", "est_survival", "first50", "occupied50", "annual_mort", "jay_n", "hum_n",
           *TESTS, "d_dry", "d_heat", "d_dry2", "d_age", "d_shade", "d_wind"]      # share of years 20-50 each condition is met; trees lost by cause
CATS = ["both birds", "jay only", "hummingbird only", "neither"]


def candidates(site, mode="round1"):
    """Candidate species per plot. round1: cedar or Douglas-fir at the cedar plots, the rest as drawn.
    open: every plot may change within its type (conifer / tall deciduous); vine maple stays (only small tree)."""
    out = {}
    for t in site["trees"]:
        s = t["species"]
        if s == "Western red cedar": c = ["Western red cedar", "Douglas-fir"]
        elif mode == "round1" or s == "Vine maple": c = [s]
        elif TREES[s]["conifer"]: c = ["Sitka spruce", "Grand fir", "Western red cedar", "Douglas-fir"]
        else: c = ["Bigleaf maple", "Red alder"]
        out[t["id"]] = c
    return out


def sample(site, cand, rng, locks=None, mgmt=None, events=None):
    """One design: {plot: species} for open plots plus the management choices. locks fixes plots or choices (anchoring).
    mgmt: management settings the designer fixed for this run; events: {event: False} for event modules switched off."""
    locks = locks or {}
    pick = {pid: locks.get(pid) or c[int(rng.integers(len(c)))] for pid, c in cand.items()}
    ch = {k: locks[k] if k in locks else v[int(rng.integers(len(v)))] for k, v in CHOICES.items()}
    return dict(plots=pick, **ch, mgmt=dict(mgmt or {}), events=dict(events or {}))


def to_run(site, d):
    design = dict(trees=[d["plots"][t["id"]] for t in site["trees"]], patch_mix=[RECIPES[d["recipe"]]] * len(site["patches"]))
    return design, dict(nurse=d["nurse"], thin=d["thin"], winter=d["winter"], water=d["water"], **d.get("mgmt", {}))


def run_d(site, d, seed, record=False):
    """Run one sampled design in one future, with its management settings and event switches."""
    design, dec = to_run(site, d)
    return run(site, design, dec, seed=seed, record=record, events=d.get("events") or True)


def measure(res, n_plots):
    """Answers to the designer's questions for one run. Bird scores are the share of years 20-50 in which
    all four habitat tests for that bird are met (the model tests habitat conditions, not bird numbers)."""
    s = res["series"]; y = slice(19, None)
    jay = np.all([s[k][y] for k in TESTS[:4]], 0).mean(); hum = np.all([s[k][y] for k in TESTS[4:]], 0).mean()
    e = s["eco"]; drop = float((np.maximum.accumulate(e) - e).max())
    return [jay, hum, 1 - s["died"].sum() / (n_plots + s["died"].sum()),      # share of all trees ever planted that did not die
            *[s["canopy"][i] for i in (9, 19, 29, 39, 49)], s["structure"][49], s["three_layers"][49],
            s["trees_stressed"][49] / max(s["trees_alive"][49], 1), e[y].mean(), drop,
            1 - s["died_young"].sum() / max(s["planted"].sum(), 1),             # plantings that got through their first five years
            s["first_alive"][49] / n_plots, s["trees_alive"][49] / n_plots,     # first-planted trees alive at 50; plots holding a living tree
            s["died"].sum() / max(s["trees_alive"].sum(), 1),
            float(np.sum([s[k][y] for k in TESTS[:4]], 0).mean()), float(np.sum([s[k][y] for k in TESTS[4:]], 0).mean()),
            *[float(s[k][y].mean()) for k in TESTS], *[float(s[k].sum()) for k in ("d_dry", "d_heat", "d_dry2", "d_age", "d_shade", "d_wind")]]   # conditions met per year, of four                   # deaths per tree per year: a result, not an input


def explore(site, cand=None, n_designs=200, n_futures=30, seed=0, locks=None, designs=None, progress=None, mgmt=None, events=None):
    """Returns designs (list of dicts) and X[design, future, metric]. Futures 0..n_futures-1 are shared by all designs."""
    cand = cand or candidates(site); rng = np.random.default_rng([seed, 9])
    designs = designs or [sample(site, cand, rng, locks, mgmt, events) for _ in range(n_designs)]
    X = np.zeros((len(designs), n_futures, len(METRICS)))
    for i, d in enumerate(designs):
        for f in range(n_futures):
            X[i, f] = measure(run_d(site, d, f), len(site["trees"]))
        if progress and (i + 1) % progress == 0: print(f"  {i + 1}/{len(designs)} designs", flush=True)
    return designs, X


def category(X, bar=0.7):
    """Class of each run: which birds have their habitat conditions met in at least `bar` of years 20-50 (J)."""
    j = X[..., METRICS.index("jay")] >= bar; h = X[..., METRICS.index("hum")] >= bar
    return np.where(j & h, 0, np.where(j, 1, np.where(h, 2, 3)))


def leverage(designs, X, metric="eco"):
    """For every open plot and every choice: mean outcome under each option, and the gap between the best and
    worst option. A large gap means this choice matters; a small one means it can be left to taste.
    Neighbour effects are averaged out here: lock the large-gap choices and run again to see them."""
    m = X[..., METRICS.index(metric)].mean(1); rows = []
    keys = [("plot", p) for p in designs[0]["plots"]] + [("choice", k) for k in CHOICES]
    for kind, k in keys:
        val = [d["plots"][k] if kind == "plot" else d[k] for d in designs]
        opts = sorted(set(val), key=str)
        if len(opts) < 2: continue
        means = {str(o): float(m[[v == o for v in val]].mean()) for o in opts}
        rows.append(dict(kind=kind, name=k, means=means, gap=max(means.values()) - min(means.values()),
                         best=max(means, key=means.get)))
    return sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r["gap"])


def frames(site, d, seed, every=10):
    """What the front end draws for one storyline: tree and shrub state at year 0 marks, then every `every` years.
    Only the design and the seed need storing; this is recomputed when the storyline is opened."""
    res = run_d(site, d, seed, record=True); s = res["series"]; out = []
    for y in [0] + list(range(every - 1, len(res["record"]), every)):
        r = res["record"][y]
        out.append(dict(year=y + 1, trees=[dict(id=t["id"], species=sp, h=h, r=rr, health=hl)
                                           for t, sp, h, rr, hl in zip(site["trees"], res["species"], r["h"], r["r"], r["health"])],
                        patches=[dict(id=p["id"], cover=c) for p, c in zip(site["patches"], r["cover"])],
                        canopy=float(s["canopy"][y]), structure=float(s["structure"][y]), three_layers=float(s["three_layers"][y]),
                        alive=int(s["trees_alive"][y]), stressed=int(s["trees_stressed"][y]),
                        tests={k: bool(s[k][y]) for k in TESTS}))
    ev = {k: [int(i) + 1 for i in np.where(v)[0]] for k, v in res["events"].items()}
    return dict(design=d, seed=seed, frames=out, events=ev)


def site_json(site, path):
    """Static base for the front end: class and elevation of every cell, plot positions. Written once."""
    json.dump(dict(cs=site["cs"], xs=[float(site["xs"][0]), float(site["xs"][-1])], ys=[float(site["ys"][0]), float(site["ys"][-1])],
                   cls=site["cls"].tolist(), z=np.round(site["E"], 2).tolist(), patch_id=site["patch_id"].tolist(),
                   trees=[dict(id=t["id"], x=t["x"], y=t["y"], X=t["X"], Y=t["Y"]) for t in site["trees"]],
                   patches=[dict(id=q["id"], area=q["area"]) for q in site["patches"]]), open(path, "w"))
